title: console-ui: serialize snapshot refresh so fixtures stay isolated
description:
As a console UI test runner, I want snapshot refreshes to run one at a time, so that a slower earlier snapshot cannot overwrite a newer board and fail later scenarios.

Overlapping `refreshSnapshot()` calls finish out of order. The slower `kanbus console snapshot` writes `cachedSnapshot` last and broadcasts stale issues or config over SSE. Fixture restore before each scenario is required, but without serialization the restore itself starts a stale refresh.

## Specification

```gherkin
Feature: Console snapshot refresh isolation
  Scenario: Comment hides agent metadata when absent
    Given the console is open
    And the console has a comment from "Sam" on task "Fix crash on startup"
    When I switch to the "Tasks" tab
    And I open the task "Fix crash on startup"
    Then the comment agent metadata should not be visible

  Scenario: Comments display in the configured time zone
    Given the console is open
    And the console configuration sets time zone "America/Los_Angeles"
    And the console has a comment from "Sam" at "2026-02-13T23:13:00.000Z" on task "Add structured logging"
    When I switch to the "Tasks" tab
    And I open the task "Add structured logging"
    Then the comment timestamp should be "Friday, February 13, 2026 3:13 PM PST"
```

## Done when

- Snapshot refresh is serialized
- Console fixtures, config, override, wiki, project-local, and virtual trees are restored before each UI scenario
- Time zone override writes force a snapshot refresh
- console-ui CI is green

comments.author: ubuntu
comments.text: Root cause: overlapping refreshSnapshot() calls. A slower earlier kanbus console snapshot wrote cachedSnapshot last and broadcast stale issues/config over SSE. Fixture restore before each scenario is kept; refresh is now serialized, restore waits until fixture issue IDs match, project-local/virtual are wiped, wiki is recreated empty, and time-zone override writes force a snapshot refresh plus reload.

comments.author: ubuntu
comments.text:
Second pass after 9e87872a still failed console-ui (14 scenarios). API writes were visible to refresh=1 but the page kept fixture state: issue timestamps stayed 2026-02-11, comments/agent rows never appeared, Now feed did not take live right-now text. Also wiping virtual/project-local hid the Project source filter.

Changes: snapshot SSE is no longer mixed with /events/realtime; a dead realtime client cannot block board broadcasts. Setup Givens reload after issue/wiki writes. Virtual-project setup creates a local issue so the source filter exists. Column 'Done' matches the exact title so Done (Legacy) does not count as a second Done column.

comments.author: ubuntu
comments.text: Third pass: 106/109 passed. Remaining three are live file-watch updates (Now right-now text and Ship trace headers). Vite was buffering /api/events so the page never saw SSE after the first snapshot. Unbuffer that proxy, add X-Accel-Buffering on the SSE stream, and after the server snapshot has the write, apply it through the page refresh hook.

comments.author: ubuntu
comments.text: console-ui is green on 8319ebbe. All 14 CI checks passed. PR 227 is ready for review. Not closing this card until the PR merges.
